paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4 as of the last update, with a decrease of 3.03% from the prior close and an increase of 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price change is based on data available up to August 14, 2026.

There is one new news item in the last 24 hours, with Bloomberg.com reporting that Fermi Inc. received a US subpoena tied to Project Matador. This news item was published on August 14, 2026. Additionally, social media posts include a mention of a WSJ article about Fermi finding a customer for its Texas AI power project, as well as an individual stating they bought 15,000 shares of FRMI.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026. There is also one Form 4 filing in the feed, and 12 proxy solicitation filings.
